description: Run the `runner` agent in `cwd` (which edits files), capture the concrete `git diff` of the change, then have the `reviewer` agent judge it and return a PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict along with the runner output, the diff, and the review. Requires a git worktree. Newly-created (untracked) files are reviewed by their contents too (bounded per file), not just by name. The diff may include pre-existing changes if the worktree was already dirty.

cwd.description: Git working tree the runner operates in (REQUIRED)

model.description: Fallback model for BOTH agents. Only useful when runner and reviewer are the same agent — model namespaces do not overlap, so one value cannot be valid for two different CLIs. For the cross-agent setup this tool recommends, use `runnerModel` / `reviewerModel`. Must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,127}.

prompt.description: Task or question to send to the runner agent

reviewer.description: Adapter name of the agent that judges the change

reviewerModel.description: Model for the REVIEWER agent, overriding `model`. Lets you review with a different engine/tier than the one that wrote the change.

runner.description: Adapter name of the agent that edits files

runnerModel.description: Model for the RUNNER agent, overriding `model`. Use this (not `model`) when runner and reviewer are different agents.

name: review_change
